ns2:course.label: Sea Power and Maritime Affairs
ns2:course.description: Investigates the characteristics of sea power and their impact on the affairs of our nation; discusses those characteristics with historical and modern applications to the United States and other world powers. Prerequisite: No prerequisite for non-NROTC students.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: No prerequisite for non-NROTC students.
